开着：只有真的选到文字才弹条 —— 拖滚动条、拖画布、拖图片，以及没选中任何东西: On: the bar only appears when text is genuinely selected — dragging a scrollbar, a canvas or an image, or pressing Ctrl+C with nothing selected, no longer summons an empty bar. Off: any drag pops an empty bar (and Ctrl+C pops one immediately), which self-drawn interfaces and games still need to reach image search / OCR.
